record.scopeNote: Current-main source facts only. This inventory is not legal advice, provider or production proof, a public-copy draft, an approval receipt, or deployment authority.

statusDefinitions.SOURCE_OBSERVED: The exact anchored source contains the stated fact; no runtime, provider, contractual, or legal conclusion follows.
statusDefinitions.SOURCE_ABSENT_BLOCKER: An expected source route, notice, contract, or control is absent at the exact anchor and blocks broader claims.
statusDefinitions.RUNTIME_READBACK_REQUIRED: Current hosted behavior or configuration needs separately authorized, sanitized runtime evidence.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED_APPROVAL: An accountable owner or qualified reviewer must decide and approve the fact, scope, or wording.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Current professional, contractual, provider, platform, or other external evidence is required.
statusDefinitions.DEFERRED_BY_EXPLICIT_POLICY: The capability remains intentionally inactive and no activation follows from this inventory.
statusDefinitions.NOT_APPLICABLE_REVIEWED: An accountable review found the item inapplicable and retained a public-safe rationale.
